column1: PER-SITE VISUAL KNOWLEDGE CATALOGUE — TEMPLATE v1.0
COPY THIS. Do not hand-assemble a catalogue. Two catalogues built before this template
existed had already diverged (5 tabs vs 7), which is the drift this prevents.
ONE WORKBOOK PER SITE. Nine tabs, in order, with these exact names. A catalogue missing
a tab is not a smaller catalogue, it is a broken one - later stages read columns by name
and fail silently when a name moves. A tab that does not apply stays present and empty.
THE BINDING RULE. Every MANIFEST row cites a charter_goal_id. A row without one is
invalid and does not execute. Mirrors the substrate rule that every relation cites a
source_event_id: provenance applied to content decisions rather than facts.
SCOPE. This workbook holds one site. The Visual Second Brain Substrate does NOT hold
this content - it holds a RES- pointer row to this workbook in 06_RESOURCES.

column2: stage 1 - index, metadata only, nothing opened or moved
stage 2 - why the site exists, in the client's words
stage 3 - what is in, what is out, and why for both
stage 4 - which content on which page. NO block column.
advisor ratifies stages 2-4 before anything is built
stage 5 - render: block types and cell content
stage 5 - page structure and asset register
stage 6 - every build run, success or failure
